column1: # Every identity of iCartoonFace's training set that is not on the exclusion list, least coherent first
# (`likeness`: the mean cosine of its pictures to the rest of the identity, by a model that never trained
# on it; tools/train/mixed.py). Ten of its pictures were read: by two readers for the least coherent fifth
# (a third where one of them said mixed), by one for the rest (two more where that one said mixed or
# unsure). Answers: one, forms (one character in different forms), stray (one other picture), mixed
# (several characters), unsure. `final` is mixed when at least two readers say so; `kept` marks an
# identity one reader called mixed and that stays.
